movies.title: One Battle After Another
movies.overview: A former radical searches for his kidnapped daughter while battling the consequences of his past.

movies.title: Weapons
movies.overview: A community searches for answers when children from the same classroom mysteriously vanish.

movies.title: Superman
movies.overview: Superman and his four-legged companion, Krypto, battle evil tech billionaire Lex Luthor.

movies.title: 40 Acres
movies.overview: In Theaters Now. After a series of plagues and wars leaves society in ruins, the Freemans are surviving on an isolated and well-protected farm, until they’re forced to make a violent stand against a ravenous militia hell bent on claiming their land.

movies.title: It Feeds
movies.overview: Prepare to feast on this slick and scary supernatural horror. After a troubled young girl bursts into their home psychiatry practice claiming an entity is feeding on her, Jordan and her clairvoyant mother must find a way to stop the evil force before the girl is consumed completely.

movies.title: Sinners
movies.overview: Twin brothers return to their hometown only to discover a great evil is waiting to welcome them.

movies.title: 28 Years Later
movies.overview: Decades after the rage virus outbreak, survivors live in isolation. When one leaves his ruthlessly quarantined island sanctuary, he uncovers haunting secrets and mutations in both the infected and the remaining humans. From director Danny Boyle and writer Alex Garland comes a bold return to the world of 28 Days Later.

movies.title: Ballerina
movies.overview: An assassin trained in the traditions of the Ruska Roma organization sets out to seek revenge after her father's death.

movies.title: The Long Walk
movies.overview: Teens participate in a grueling contest where they must continuously walk or be shot to death.

movies.title: The Shrouds
movies.overview: In the near future, a techno-entrepreneur develops a new software that allows the bereaved to witness the gradual decay of their loved ones. As graves utilizing this technology are vandalized, he uncovers a potentially vast conspiracy. Starring Vincent Cassel and Diane Kruger, David Cronenberg's latest film is both a profoundly personal reckoning with grief and a descent into noir-tinged dystopia.

movies.title: Caught Stealing
movies.overview: Austin Butler, Zoë Kravitz, and Matt Smith star this thriller where a series of misunderstandings lead a burned-out baseball player into a violent chase with the mafia in a hectic 1990s New York.

movies.title: Final Destination Bloodlines
movies.overview: A young woman heads home to track down the one person who might be able to break the cycle of death.

movies.title: The Conjuring: Last Rites
movies.overview: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren try to vanquish a demon from a family's home.

movies.title: Americana
movies.overview: The lives of local outsiders and outcasts violently intertwine when a rare Lakota Ghost shirt falls onto the black market in a small South Dakota town. Unlikely heroes and villains must navigate a new playing field in pursuit of this legendary Native American artifact renowned for bringing its owner power, fortune, or freedom. Stars Sydney Sweeney, Paul Walter Hauser, Halsey, and Zahn McClarnon.

movies.title: Sharp Corner
movies.overview: A troubled man begins to spiral, consumed by the fatal car crashes caused by the sharp corner in front of his house. As his sick obsession takes hold, he places his wife and son in jeopardy, threatening to permanently break the family apart.

movies.title: Locked
movies.overview: From producer Sam Raimi, this horror-thriller follows a petty thief (Bill Skarsgård) who breaks into the wrong car and becomes prey to its vengeful owner (Anthony Hopkins). Eddie faces a deadly game of survival, where escape is an illusion, and justice shifts into high gear.

movies.title: Karate Kid: Legends
movies.overview: After relocating to New York City, kung fu prodigy Li Fong attracts unwanted attention and embarks on a journey to enter the ultimate karate competition. Guided by the wisdom of his kung fu teacher, Mr. Han, and the legendary Daniel LaRusso, Li merges their unique styles to prepare for an epic martial arts showdown.

movies.title: Haunted Harmony Mysteries: Buried at C
movies.overview: Gethsemane solves a murder on the sea with help from her ghost friend Eamon.

movies.title: Mickey 17
movies.overview: After a disposable employee dies, a new body is regenerated with most of his memories intact.

movies.title: I'm Still Here
movies.overview: When her husband disappears at the hands of Brazil's military dictatorship in 1971, Eunice Paiva protects her close-knit family with courage and dignity.

movies.title: Until Dawn
movies.overview: One year after her sister Melanie's disappearance, Clover and her friends head into the remote valley where she vanished in search of answers. In an abandoned visitor center, they are hunted and murdered one by one ... only to find themselves reliving the night again and again - each time with a new terrifying threat. With limited deaths left, they must survive Until Dawn to escape.

movies.title: Everything's Going to Be Great
movies.overview: This heartfelt dramedy about big dreams and self-discovery stars Bryan Cranston and Allison Janney.

movies.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
movies.overview: When a deadly secret resurfaces, five friends are stalked by a vengeful killer.

movies.title: A Minecraft Movie
movies.overview: Four misfits are pulled through a portal into the Overworld, a cubic wonderland of imagination. To get back home, they'll have to master this world while embarking on a magical quest with an unexpected expert crafter, Steve.

movies.title: Signed, Sealed, Delivered: To the Moon and Back
movies.overview: The POstables take a road trip to find a musician who has key information.

movies.title: The Surfer
movies.overview: Nicolas Cage returns to the beach of his childhood to surf, where he is drawn into a conflict that pushes him to his breaking point. Thriller. (2024)(97 mins)

movies.title: The Marching Band
movies.overview: Acclaimed conductor Thibaut has leukemia and needs a bone marrow donor. Learning he was adopted, he finds an younger brother, a musician and factory worker. Their reunion sparks a fraternal, musical journey amidst the town's factory closure.

movies.title: The Apprentice
movies.overview: In 70s New York, aspiring mogul Donald Trump meets the man who will become one of the most important figures in his life: political fixer Roy M. Cohn.

movies.title: Reality Bites: A Hannah Swensen Mystery
movies.overview: The Cookie Jar is shut down when a reality cooking show producer is found dead.

movies.title: Death of a Unicorn
movies.overview: A father (Paul Rudd) and daughter (Jenna Ortega) accidentally hit and kill a unicorn while en route to a weekend retreat, where his billionaire boss (Richard E. Grant) seeks to exploit the creature’s miraculous curative properties.

movies.title: Joy to the World
movies.overview: When a lifestyle guru’s carefully crafted, fictional "perfect family" is suddenly expected to appear on a live Christmas Eve special, she recruits friends and neighbors to pose as her family - including her best friend, who still has feelings for her.

movies.title: To Barcelona, Forever
movies.overview: Five months after the Saint Jordi Festival, Nico takes Erica on a romantic date and proposes, surprising her with a ring, and Anna, who was able to come back to Barcelona amid her work on her own growing travel food blog, to celebrate the pair. Anna takes the chance, being back in Spain, to visit a special shop that sells some of the best saffron in the world for only one week out of the year.

movies.title: To Barcelona, with Love
movies.overview: Erica (Alison Sweeney), an American expat in Barcelona, makes a living translating novels. Though she secretly dreams of writing, she's held back by self-doubt until she encounters Barcelona, Mi Amor, a romance novel that misses the mark on love and her beloved city. Frustrated by its inaccuracies, Erica revises it with her own flair, and it becomes a local hit.

movies.title: The Alabama Solution
movies.overview: In 2019, filmmakers Andrew Jarecki and Charlotte Kaufman (HBO's The Jinx) visit a prison where incarcerated men whisper a message: terrible things are going on and kept secret. This sparks an immersive six-year investigation into one of the nation's deadliest prison systems. Through unprecedented access and video shot on contraband cell phones, we learn of a suspicious death, revealing it isn't an isolated incident and the official version seems far from the truth. A shocking story of brutality, corruption, and a system in collapse. The Alabama Solution shines a light on inmates fighting for survival who embark on a non-violent campaign of resistance. Beyond Alabama, it exposes a national crisis that is an urgent warning about the true costs of mass incarceration.

movies.title: Pie To Die For: A Hannah Swensen Mystery
movies.overview: When Hannah's customer and Delores' theater rival is murdered, Hannah must find her killer in order to save her mother's reputation. Chad and Hannah's

movies.title: A Complete Unknown
movies.overview: In New York, 1961, an unknown nineteen-year-old named Bob Dylan arrives with his guitar and revolutionary talent. He forges intimate relationships with music icons of Greenwich Village on his meteoric rise, culminating in a groundbreaking and controversial performance that reverberates worldwide.

movies.title: My Mom Jayne
movies.overview: ​In her feature film directorial debut, Emmy®- and Golden Globe-winning actress and filmmaker Mariska Hargitay (producer of HBO's I Am Evidence) delves into her mother Jayne Mansfield's story for the first time – searching for the mother she never knew almost six decades after the Hollywood legend's tragic death. Just three years old when Jayne died in a car accident at the age of 34, Mariska seeks to answer her long-held questions about her mother and integrate the truths she uncovers into her own sense of self. Through intimate interviews and an extensive collection of never-before-seen photos and home movies, My Mom Jayne is a testament to the transformative rewards of an unflinching search for truth, unveiling Mariska's journey to reclaim her mother's story – and her own.

movies.title: A Paw Patrol Christmas
movies.overview: Rubble can't wait for Christmas to come this year as he's especially looking forward to Santa bringing him a Lazer Drill. But when all of Adventure Bay learns that Santa has come down with a cold and Christmas is cancelled, Mayor Humdinger decides he's going to go to the North Pole and take all of the gifts for himself. It will take all the PAW Patrol and Rubble making a sacrifice to stop Mayor Humdinger from ruining Christmas and learning the true meaning of the season.

movies.title: The Friend
movies.overview: Based on the bestselling novel, writer and teacher Iris (Naomi Watts) finds her comfortable, solitary New York life thrown into disarray after her closest friend and mentor (Bill Murray) bequeaths her his beloved Great Dane, Apollo. The regal yet intractable dog immediately creates practical problems for Iris, from furniture destruction to eviction notices, as well as more existential ones.

movies.title: Parthenope
movies.overview: In 1950, near the Bay of Naples, young Parthenope is born in the Mediterranean Sea, just outside the crumbling castle where she will spend her childhood. She is named - by her familys rich, boorish benefactor - after the legendary Greek siren associated with the foundation of what became modern-day Naples.

movies.title: Flow
movies.overview: Following an intrepid cat on a heart-stopping journey through an animated world of wonder and peril, Gints Zilbalodis’s Oscar®-winner is a moving ode to friendship. With delightfully expressive animal characters, stunning visuals, and immersive sound design, Flow captures nature in all its majesty.

movies.title: I Am Raquel Welch
movies.overview: Celebrating the life of an actress and single mother who redefined the idea of a sex symbol.

movies.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
movies.overview: Marvel Studios presents their most significant mistake yet. His days as Deadpool behind him, a listless Wade Wilson toils away in civilian life. But when his homeworld is threatened, he reluctantly suits up as he tries to convince Wolverine… oh hell, just watch. Warning: Some flashing-lights scenes in this film may affect photosensitive viewers.

movies.title: Wick Is Pain
movies.overview: WICK IS PAIN is the true story behind the John Wick phenomenon, starring Keanu Reeves-from independent film to billion-dollar franchise.

movies.title: Beating Hearts
movies.overview: Starring the inimitable Adèle Exarchopoulos and cowritten with Audrey Diwan, this thrilling film zooms from criminal underworld to teen romance, ricocheting through time and genre. Quickening pulses and breaking hearts, Gilles Lelouche’s second solo-directed feature pops with outrageous flair.

movies.title: Heart Eyes
movies.overview: When the "Heart Eyes Killer" strikes, a pair of co-workers pulling overtime on Valentine’s Day are mistaken for a couple by the elusive couple-hunting killer. Now they must spend the most romantic night of the year running for their lives.

movies.title: Seven Veils
movies.overview: An earnest theater director has the task of remounting her former mentor's most famous work, the opera Salome. Some disturbing memories from her past will allow her repressed trauma to color the present.

movies.title: Salvable
movies.overview: Shia LaBeouf and Toby Kebbell star in this powerful story of redemption, following a down-and-out prize fighter who has to stand alone and take the biggest swing of his life to reclaim his dreams.

movies.title: The Wish Swap
movies.overview: CASEY and HENRY make birthday wishes but receive each other's wishes.

movies.title: Boxcutter
movies.overview: Aspiring rapper Rome must get his album to megastar Richie Hill before a big event. But after a break-in steals his only copy, he and his friend Jenaya race to reassemble it from four producers in time for the opportunity that could change his life.

movies.title: The Wedding Banquet
movies.overview: When Min's boyfriend Chris rejects his spontaneous marriage proposal, Min convinces his best friend Angela to marry him instead, paying for her wife Lee's IVF treatments in exchange for his own green card. Their plans for a subtle city hall elopement are turned upside down when Min's grandmother travels to town to throw them an extravagant Korean wedding banquet.

movies.title: Night of the Zoopocalypse
movies.overview: When a meteor unleashes a virus that turns zoo animals into zombies, a mountain lion and a wolf lead a team of survivors to save the day.

movies.title: The Strangers: Chapter 2
movies.overview: After learning that one of their victims, Maya, is still alive, three masked maniacs return to finish the job. With nowhere to run and no one to trust, Maya soon finds herself in a brutal fight for survival against psychopaths who are more than willing to kill anyone who stands in their way.

movies.title: Die Alone
movies.overview: An amnesiac bands together with a loner survivalist as he sifts through fragmented memories to find his lost girlfriend amid a zombie apocalypse.

movies.title: A Real Pain
movies.overview: Mismatched cousins tour Poland to honor their beloved grandmother.

movies.title: Aurora Teagarden Mysteries: Death at the Diner
movies.overview: Aurora's new boyfriend becomes the primary suspect in a murder.

movies.title: Darkest Miriam
movies.overview: Miriam Gordon lives in a fog of grief while working in a downtown public library branch. When a burgeoning love-affair coincides with her receiving a series of oddly threatening letters, Miriam's sheltered existence is cracked open.

movies.title: Mountainhead
movies.overview: Written, directed, and executive produced by Emmy® winner Jesse Armstrong (HBO's Succession), Mountainhead follows a group of tech billionaires who gather against the backdrop of a rolling international crisis.

movies.title: The Room Next Door
movies.overview: Ingrid (Julianne Moore) and Martha (Tilda Swinton) were close friends in their youth, when they worked together at the same magazine. Ingrid went on to become a novelist while Martha became a war reporter. Separated by the circumstances of life and after years of being out of touch, they meet again in an extreme but strangely sweet situation. Directed by Academy Award winner Pedro Almodovar.

movies.title: Queen of the Ring
movies.overview: In a time when pro wrestling for women was illegal all over the United States, a small town single mother embraces the danger as she dominates a peculiar American niche entertainment industry & becomes the first millionaire female athlete.

movies.title: Small Things Like These
movies.overview: A loving father (Cillian Murphy) finds disturbing secrets at a local convent, forcing him to confront the complicit silence of a small Irish town controlled by the Catholic Church.

movies.title: Savvy Sheldon Feels Good As Hell
Tornado
movies.overview: Tornado vows to seek vengeance and forge her own destiny.

movies.title: Armed Only with a Camera: The Life and Death of Brent Renaud
movies.overview: On March 13, 2022, filmmaker Brent Renaud was killed by Russian soldiers while reporting on the war in Ukraine. Later, his younger brother and collaborator, Craig Renaud, recovered Brent's body and his final recordings and brought them back to their childhood home in Arkansas. As Brent's journey to his final resting place unfolds, the award-winning short film chronicles the years he and his brother spent covering some of the world's most dangerous conflicts. Unflinching in its depiction of death, loss, and the toll of war, the film is a tribute to Brent and all the devoted journalists who use their cameras to work for truth and understanding.

movies.title: Broke
movies.overview: Bareback bronc rider True Brandywine gets trapped in a freak spring blizzard. While fighting for his survival, True is forced to face his choices and the circumstances that led him to his tenuous situation.

movies.title: A '90s Christmas
movies.overview: Workaholic lawyer Lucy Miller celebrates her promotion alone on Christmas Eve, but a mysterious rideshare takes her back to 1999.

movies.title: The Alto Knights
movies.overview: The Alto Knights stars Academy Award winner Robert De Niro in a dual role, directed by Academy Award-winning filmmaker Barry Levinson.

movies.title: Venom: The Last Dance
movies.overview: Still on the run, journalist Eddie Brock and his alien companion Venom dodge threats from a vigilant military leader and a ruthless, predatory creature.

movies.title: Flight Risk
movies.overview: A flight on a small plane takes a treacherous turn for a U.S. marshal and a government witness.

movies.title: Frankie Freako
movies.overview: Workaholic yuppie Conor is in an existential rut until one night he responds to a bizarre ad for a party hotline hosted by a strange dancing goblin.

movies.title: The Last Showgirl
movies.overview: Pamela Anderson gives a revelatory performance in this poignant drama from director Gia Coppola. With zesty support from Jamie Lee Curtis and original songs by Miley Cyrus, The Last Showgirl burnishes the tarnished rhinestones of downtown Las Vegas for a reflective study in artistic resilience.

movies.title: Hurry Up Tomorrow
movies.overview: A musician plagued by insomnia is pulled into an odyssey with a stranger who begins to unravel the very core of his existence.

movies.title: Paddington in Peru
movies.overview: PADDINGTON IN PERU brings Paddington's story back to Peru as he returns to visit his beloved Aunt Lucy, who resides at the Home for Retired Bears. With the Brown Family in tow, a thrilling adventure ensues when a mystery plunges them into an unexpected journey through the Amazon rainforest and up to the mountain peaks of Peru.

movies.title: Renovation Romance
movies.overview: A couple hosting a popular home-renovation reality show find their own shabby relationship in need of repair while filming a holiday special.

movies.title: Juror #2
movies.overview: A juror for a high-profile murder trial finds himself struggling with a serious moral dilemma that could influence the verdict and potentially convict, or free, the accused killer.

movies.title: Soundtrack to a Coup d'Etat
movies.overview: With the Congo independence as its backdrop, the film fuses the wave of African independence, the U.S. civil rights movement, the Cold War and the U.S. most unconventional weapon: Jazz.

movies.title: Signed, Sealed, Delivered: A Tale of Three Letters
movies.overview: The POstables are back identifying the intended recipients of a trio of dead letters which have a surprising, personal impact on all of them. Stars Eric Mabius, Kristin Booth, Crystal Lowe, Geoff Gustafson, Rhiannon Fish.

movies.title: Shadow Force
movies.overview: In SHADOW FORCE, Kyrah (Washington) and Isaac (Sy) were once the leaders of a multinational special forces group called Shadow Force. They broke the rules by falling in love, and in order to protect their son, they go underground.

movies.title: Memoir of a Snail
movies.overview: Grace Pudel is a lonely misfit with a love for collecting ornamental snails. When Grace is separated from her fire-breathing twin brother Gilbert, she falls into a spiral of anxiety and angst. Despite a series of hardships, hope emerges when she strikes up an enduring friendship with an eccentric woman named Pinky, who is full of grit and lust for life. From Academy Award®-winning Adam Elliot.

movies.title: One of Them Days
movies.overview: SZA and Keke Palmer star in this buddy comedy as best friends Alyssa and Dreux, who, after learning that Alyssa's boyfriend has blown their rent money, embark on a wild quest through L.A. to raise enough cash before they get evicted.

movies.title: Hard Truths
movies.overview: Pansy, angry and depressed, lashes out at family and strangers. Her constant criticism isolates her, except from her cheerful sister Chantelle, who remains sympathetic despite their differences.

movies.title: Kraven the Hunter
movies.overview: The brutal origin story of Marvel's iconic villain Kraven, who becomes the world's greatest hunter.

movies.title: The Family McMullen
movies.overview: This sequel to the 1995 indie hit "The Brothers McMullen" tracks the romantic entanglements of Barry McMullen and his 20-something kids as well as his brother Patrick and widowed sister-in-law Molly, who are also facing unexpected romantic hurdles.

movies.title: Surviving Ohio State
movies.overview: Based on the article, Why Aren't More People Talking About the Ohio State Sex Abuse Scandal?
